reason: First mixed-source run recovered TeleTrade NFP/unemployment/AHE-MoM values but rejected all TeleTrade timestamps because visible feed timestamps lacked an explicit offset.
Baker AHE-YoY rows were present in the PDFs but pypdf flattened-text ordering prevented reliable extraction for several months.

basis: The same TeleTrade daily feed labels scheduled macro-event times explicitly as GMT.
On 2021-03-05 the feed posts U.S. NFP release entries at 13:30, matching the same page's 13:30 GMT schedule and frozen BLS T0.
On 2021-10-08 the feed posts U.S. NFP release entries at 12:30, matching the same page's 12:30 GMT schedule and frozen BLS DST-aware T0.
Therefore the historical feed article clock is independently resolved against known GMT event clocks for the exact source family/year.
teletrade_clock_resolution.allowed_interpretation: Visible TeleTrade historical feed timestamp DD.MM.YYYY HH:MM is interpreted as GMT for this 2021 source census.

baker_parser_correction.basis: Baker PDFs expose a Weekly Economic Calendar with columns Date, Release, Per., Est., Actual, Prior, Revised. The frozen field is the Est. value on the Average Hourly Earnings YoY row.
